title: Frontend: Sharing panel — toggle public, copy share URL, revoke button
description: Sharing section in project settings. Toggle to make project public, copy share URL, and revoke the link.
acceptanceCriteria: Switch toggle to enable/disable public sharing
When enabled: shows the full share URL with copy button
Copy button copies URL to clipboard, shows 'Copied!' toast
'Revoke link' button: opens confirmation dialog, calls revoke API

steps.details: Create src/components/project/SharingPanel.tsx. Use shadcn/ui Switch for toggle. When toggled on: POST /share/enable. Show URL in a read-only Input with a CopyButton. 'Revoke' button: AlertDialog confirmation → POST /share/revoke.
Enable sharing. Copy URL — open in incognito — verify share page loads. Revoke. Try old URL in incognito — verify 404.
